data.heading: Pay your MasterCard Credit Card bill through upay anytime, anywhere in Bangladesh
data.heading bn: Pay your MasterCard Credit Card bill through upay anytime, anywhere in Bangladesh
data.desc:
Now upay users will be able to pay any MasterCard Credit Card bills issued by commercial banks operating in Bangladesh. The service is available from upay customer app only.

The applicable Limits and Frequency for Master Credit Card bill are given below:

Per Transaction Limit (Amount in BDT)
Minimum Maximum
100 25,000

Daily Transaction Limit (Amount in BDT)
Count Amount
N/A N/A

Monthly Transaction Limit (Amount in BDT)
Count Amount
N/A N/A

Customer will be charged 0.8% of total bill amount by upay.


Terms and Conditions

- Only active (full profile) customers with sufficient balance will be eligible for this service through upay app.
- A customer can avail this service multiple times with the conditions of applicable local (Bangladesh) credit limit.
- Payment will be updated within 3 working days after bill payment. However, if the customer is charged a late fee by the bank for making a last-minute credit card bill through upay, then the customer has to contact the card-issuing bank to resolve the issue.
- Customer must follow the applicable payment rules of their concerned bank.
- Customer will be charged by upay for this credit card bill payment service as determined by upay from time to time.
- upay shall only be responsible for payment as a payment service provider. Visa/Mastercard will bear the sole responsibility and liability of its credit card services.
- upay reserves the right to change/modify/amend these terms & conditions or applicable charges of bill payment service or cancel this service at any time without giving any prior notice.
- Any decision taken by upay in respect to this service, shall be in the sole discretion of upay and shall be deemed final.
- For details Terms & Condition, click HERE.
